title: Stop a scheduled task
description: Stop the running instance of a scheduled task

parameters.name: taskname
parameters.label: Task name
parameters.description: Name of the task to stop

parameters.name: taskpath
parameters.label: Path
parameters.description: Task path (e.g. \CustomTasks\), passed positionally after the task name

examples.description: Example using the 'taskpath' parameter: Task path. Replace \Microsoft\Windows\ with the value that fits your environment.

notes: Ends the run immediately. Use it with care on critical tasks.
